title: Narrator clip: the channeler's second trance in front of Friend

tellings.quote: He sat for several minutes and then appeared in a deep trance with his Adam's apple moving up and down rapidly.

plain: In a clip played on Jesse Michels's podcast, an unnamed narrator describes a scene in Washington, D.C., in 1959. A channeler, someone who claims to pass along messages from other beings while in a trance, is said to have gone into trance a second time in front of a man named Friend. According to the narrator, the man sat for several minutes and then seemed to fall into a deep trance, his Adam's apple moving rapidly up and down, which would suggest contact with non-human beings was being tested in front of government witnesses.
